title: Original-DOS container fixture
description: One container case run through the executed routines (demo): a move order onto a transporter or a building as step-fixture.schema.json runs it, now with the container branches of the end-cell check 10cc:0f74 and the arrival actions 2, 4 and 5 of 10cc:0ae2; or a unit leaving a container through the main loop's exit branch 0661:2f0a-30fe, then a move order. The map fields are those of movement-fixture.schema.json; numbers only, unit types and terrain index the build's records in movement-tables.json. Container records are indexed from 32e2:310c in steps of 0x1c bytes: 0-69 transporters (live +0x0a), 70-71 the buildings of terrain flag 0x40, 72-81 of flag 0x100, 82-91 of flag 0x400. A record not listed has free slots (0xff) and zeros otherwise.

flags6.description: Live word +6 (the type's +0x11): 0x10 a cost of 2 per cell and the exit budget 4; bits 0xfc0 the classes a transporter's record must share.

hold.description: Live +0x0a: the container record a transporter's cargo sits in; omitted for 0.

slots.description: Seven slot bytes per side (side 0 first): a live unit index, or above 0xf0 free.

cells.description: Four map offsets (+0x0e): a building's cells as 2 * cell; a transporter's first is its position 2 * cell + 1.

flags.description: Word +0x19: side bits 1 and 2 as in live +4 (2 a neutral building), 0x20 a transporter, 0xfc0 the classes a transporter takes.

occupant.description: Byte +0x1b: the map occupant the container's cell gets back when a unit leaves it (the transporter's index, 0xf4 a building with units).

units.description: Units on the moving side's own map.

unseen.description: Units on the other side's map only.

unit.description: The moving unit; for an exit, the unit in the slot.

budget.description: Live byte 0 of the moving unit (an exit ignores it).

block.description: The terrain flag mask of a move order's reach search (an exit computes its own).

held.description: Units only in container slots, on neither map.

records.description: The container records set up before the case.

hold.description: The record the unit leaves; -1 a move order.

slot.description: The moving side's slot the unit leaves.

goal.description: Destination cell of the move order.

retarget.description: Cell the destination is changed to between the order code and the start; -1 none.

messages.description: [code, side] of every status message shown: an end code (0x37, 0x39, 0x3a classes or a moved transporter, 0x3b no slot or too heavy, 0x40) or 0x48 on refusal, 0x38 on arrival.

occupants.description: [cell, occupant] of every cell of the side's map and of the other side's map whose occupant byte is not 0xff afterwards (0xf4 a building with units); terrain bytes are unchanged.

holds.description: The 0x1c bytes of every container record that changed.

remaining.description: For an exit: [cell, budget left] of every cell its reach search reached (the start holds the exit budget, 4 or 8). Empty for a move order.
